title: The Light of Sun, Moon and Fire
translation: The light in the sun that lights the whole world, the light in the moon and in fire: know that light to be mine.
translation_hi: जो तेज सूर्य में स्थित होकर सारे जगत को प्रकाशित करता है, और जो चंद्रमा और अग्नि में है, उस तेज को मेरा ही जानो।
science: Moonlight is sunlight reflected off the Moon's surface, and the energy in firewood is sunlight stored by plants through photosynthesis. In a sense all three lights are one light.
